summary: Behrend's campaign platform demands San Francisco divest completely and immediately from Israel, calling the actions 'genocide and apartheid' and refusing to renew contracts with companies doing business there. On June 28, 2026, he publicly attacked Supervisor Scott Wiener for opposing the 2024 ceasefire resolution, invoking ICJ war-crimes citations and comparing armed settlers to lynch mobs. CAIR Action endorsed him in the general; Vote for Peace rated him an Ally.
